issues: The original was a greyscale placeholder dashboard with a small-type palette; 19–25px text is unreadable at 1080p
The palette just scaled linearly to 0 in 5f with a tiny dot, so 'collapse point = ripple origin' did not register
The ripple filled the frame in 22f, so the circle barely read
Both themes were neutral grey with no accent or light, and nothing changed once dark mode settled
changes: The subject is a full-bleed music library, Overtone: a 112px Library title, five 259px procedural album covers and a now-playing bar whose progress keeps moving; covers stay identical across themes, only the UI shell changes
Custom look: cool porcelain grey-white for light, near-black graphite for dark, with a coral accent reserved for the selected row, playback progress and the ripple
The palette is 980px wide with a 46px query and 32px rows; 'dark' is typed at an uneven human rhythm, the top row turns coral and the return keycap presses
The collapse is a CRT power-off: it squashes into a white-hot line, then shrinks into a dot, and the dot plus a horizontal afterglow holds in place for 5f before the ripple starts there

The ripple runs 34f with a strong ease-out to 1260px so the circle reads throughout, with a 3px white-hot ring, coral outer glow and an echo ring 4f behind; dark settles 1.035→1, and the camera pushes to 1.03 while typing and exhales back on the ripple
Once dark settles each cover casts a matching glow onto the dark stage, light you only see in dark mode
